definitions.explanation: Something that happens without warning or preparation. Often used in the pattern {不意|ふい}を{突|つ}く (to catch off guard) or {不意|ふい}に (suddenly, unexpectedly).

examples.english: Someone suddenly called out to me.

examples.japanese: {不意|ふい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{来客|らいきゃく}→来客：13061_raikyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised by an unexpected visitor.

examples.japanese: {不意|ふい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}かれて→突く：12735_tsuku⟧、⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{言|い}い{返|かえ}せなかった→言い返す：16418_iikaesu⟧。
examples.english: I was caught off guard and couldn't say anything back.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {不意|ふい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: suddenly, unexpectedly (adverbial use)
- {不意|ふい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧: to catch off guard, to take by surprise
- {不意|ふい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: unexpected ~ (adjectival use with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧)

FORMS:
{不|ふ} (not) + ⟦{意|い}→意：30489_i⟧ (intention, expectation)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不意|ふい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧: unexpected visit
- {不意|ふい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}かれる→突く：12735_tsuku⟧: to be caught off guard
- {不意|ふい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: tears come unexpectedly
